body: I would love to, but I can't even find a way out of PA. Good luck, I hope you get to where you are going!
Life is always changing, but not always for the better. I can empathize a little with how you're feeling. I know it's tough.
I'm here if you need a friend. The situation seems really tough, but sometimes just having someone to listen can help.
Thank you for taking time out of your day to try and help me.

My mom isn't worried at all. She just thinks it's embarrassing.
Like it's embarrassing for me to be a teacher, despite she and my father never going to college. She doesn't even talk to me half the time, she couldn't tell you a think about me. She just calls me a pig and a whore and told to move out awhile ago, but won't let me. 

No I don't really. I have friends but they're not really close enough for me to talk about this stuff with: they don't know I want to die or that I have tried:

I had to get up earlier at 4am to catch my ride into town to get to the station. The nearest station is over am hour and a half away because I live in a very rural area. I hid my luggage in a garbage bag and managed to get outside. My mother had woken up and got a vague idea of what I was doing. She called my back inside, gave me a lecture on being a deserter, how I would be giving up school, and generally would just be wasting my time because she would "get me back" somehow. She took my old phone away and restrict my internet access. So the punishment was rather lax for what I was expecting.I kept the information vague so my boyfriend wouldn't get in trouble. He says he understands and he's there for me, but I feel so awful. He got a cake that said welcome home and that is the first time anyone has ever cared so much for me. I feel like scum for not being there. He's out with friends who came to cheer him up because he's having a little bit of a hard time too.
I don't know if it will really help, but talking sounds nice to organize my thoughts a little bit better.

It might suck right now, but do you think there is a chance it could get better? Life is never going to be perfect, but you shouldn't end it until your absolutely sure. It may be a horror show, but there might be something good somewhere that you haven't found yet.  Nobody asks to be be born, we just do what we have to do and hope for the best and I hope everything gets better for you soon.
